summary: The ChangePassword module implements a web-based user interface and backend for users to securely change their account password. It enforces stringent password rules, displays user responsibilities and policy texts, and requires user agreement to privacy policies before allowing password changes.
purpose: To enable authenticated users to change their password in compliance with organization security policies, ensuring the new password meets complexity requirements and the user agrees to privacy/user responsibility policies.

actors.description: Performs validations, updates password, and displays messages

workflows.name: Change Password
steps: User reads the policy text and checks agreement.
User enters new password and repeats new password.
System validates all fields (current password, new password rules, agreement checkbox).
If validations pass, system updates the password and redirects user with a success message.
If validations fail, error messages are shown and user can retry.

business_rules: User must agree to the policy/privacy statement before changing password.
New password must not match the current password.
New password and confirmation must match.
New password must be at least 12 characters.
New password must contain at least one digit and one letter.
New password must contain at least one upper and one lower case letter.
New password must contain at least one symbol.

validations.message: Your new password must be different from your current password.
New password must be a combination of letters and digits.
New password must contain upper and lower case letters.
New password must contain a symbol.
You must agree to the policies.

calculations.name: Password Strength
calculations.description: Evaluates the strength of the new password based on length, inclusion of numbers, symbols, upper and lower case letters.

conditions: Password change only permitted if all validation rules pass.
Redirect to Tools.aspx upon successful password change or cancellation.
system_behavior: Displays error panels for validation failures.
Displays warning panels for status messages.
Uses AJAX controls for UI enhancements.
Loads policy text dynamically based on user session.
Focus on current password input on page load.
dependencies: AJAX Control Toolkit for UI elements.
HSPnet Framework for session and page management.
Help policy records for the user policy text.

exceptions.name: Validation Failure
exceptions.description: One or more validation rules fail; user is shown error messages and can retry.

exceptions.name: No Policy Agreement
exceptions.description: User has not agreed to user responsibility/policy; password change not permitted.

content_gaps: Policy text contents are dynamically loaded and not present in source.
Resource values for error messages and labels are referenced but not provided.
Password change implementation detail (actual storage and security mechanism) is abstracted in Security.ChangePassword.
